btc_strength_index.name: BTC Strength Index
btc_strength_index.applies_to: ALL 11 altcoins in universe except BTC
btc_strength_index.missing_anchor_or_quote_action: BSI_DATA_ERROR; do not invent or propose sale
btc_strength_index.sale_fraction_first_of_real_unreserved_e: DEPRECATED_v5.3.3: fraction now multiplies TOTAL ALT units, then capped to free Exchange.
btc_strength_index.sale_fraction_incremental_of_real_unrese: DEPRECATED_v5.3.3: fraction now multiplies TOTAL ALT units, then capped to free Exchange.
btc_strength_index.deduplication: Per-token activation BSI + fully reconciled high-water mark; guard pending/partially filled BSI SELL plan by ID until reconciliation. Partial fills credited once and never raise full high-water mark by themselves.
btc_strength_index.sale_inventory: real Exchange units MINUS outstanding SELL reservations, NEVER Core/HODL and NEVER BTC
btc_strength_index.surplus_proceeds_destination: 100pct net confirmed ALT SELL proceeds to PROPOSED BTC BUY, NOT USDT retained as strategic destination
btc_strength_index.btc_purchase_requires: confirmed ALT sell fill, liquidity 40% protected, BTC quote freshness and separate confirmed BUY fill before BTC units update
btc_strength_index.if_liquidity_below_40pct: DEFER BTC CONVERSION; retain proceeds temporarily unconverted pending 40pct protection and clearly label status
btc_strength_index.does_not_spend: C1, C2, Quantfury Trading reserve or unverified sale proceeds
btc_strength_index.post_approval_baseline_status: PENDING_VERIFIED_SIMULTANEOUS_QUOTES_AFTER_RULE_APPROVAL; first Oct15 morning reading informative not synchronized/certified
btc_strength_index.historical_vs_new_policy: Oct05->activation historical excess reported INFO ONLY. Only BSI increase verified after eligibility-baseline timestamp can trigger NEW_BSI_EXCESS; independent HWM of truly monetized fills. Do not classify historical BSI>20 as new signal.
btc_strength_index.incremental_sale_threshold_pct: BSI>20 trigger and BSI>max(0,activation_BSI,last_confirmed_monetized_BSI) for eligible incremental gain; historical gain not monetizable.
btc_strength_index.source_caveats: Current BSI quotes exclusively synchronized Binance Spot 4H; historical Oct05 legacy cross-venue anchors require MCP recertification review before new actionable SELL; DO NOT fallback to images.
btc_strength_index.capture_basis: 50pct of eligible relative BTC outperformance, not only gain above threshold; trigger strictly BSI>20; no retroactive historical gain
btc_strength_index.partial_fill_safety: New BSI proposals BLOCKED while any BSI sell plan is pending or partially filled/unreconciled. Actual fill quantity and ID posted once; cancel/reconcile remainder before next plan. No duplicate sale of same relative gain.
